meta.source: Rental-Ui/src/styles.css values as given in the Stage 1 brief (codebase not read in this session)

tokens.name: ui-color-primary
tokens.usage: Brand orange. Fills, icons and decorative accents only. Never behind white text (3.0:1) and never as small text.

tokens.name: ui-color-primary-strong
tokens.usage: Text-safe orange: primary buttons with white text (5.0:1), links, the camera glyph in the badge, initials (4.6:1 on primary-wash), and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ui-color-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Pressed tint for quiet rows and menu items; selected states.

tokens.name: ui-color-primary-wash
tokens.usage: Initials avatar fill. Hover tint for quiet rows and menu items.

tokens.name: ui-color-background
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards on mobile and desktop.

tokens.name: ui-color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the popup menu, dialogs, the camera badge.

tokens.name: ui-color-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary (Cancel) button fill; quiet chips.

tokens.name: ui-color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, titles, menu labels and the error message, on surface, background, surface-muted and error-surface.

tokens.name: ui-color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Captions, sheet titles, the uploading caption and the dialog body: on surface (5.3:1), background (5.0:1) and surface-muted (4.9:1).

tokens.name: ui-color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and badge outlines, sheet grab handle. Decorative only (1.3:1): never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: ui-color-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive: the Remove confirm button fill (white text 5.3:1), the quiet Remove photo row text and icon on surface (5.3:1), the error icon.

tokens.name: ui-color-danger-surface
tokens.usage: Tinted circle behind the trash icon in the remove confirm (danger on it 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ui-color-error-surface
tokens.usage: Inline photo error panel fill; text-primary on it, danger icon (4.8:1).

tokens.name: ui-color-error-border
tokens.usage: Inline photo error panel outline. Decorative; the icon and words carry the meaning.

tokens.name: ui-color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: NEW. 2px solid ring, 2px offset, around the avatar button and every control in sheets, menu and dialog. 4.7:1 on background, 5.0:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ui-color-scrim
tokens.usage: NEW. Over the avatar while uploading (with a white spinner) and, in entry option 2, on desktop hover/press with a white camera icon.

tokens.name: ui-color-backdrop
tokens.usage: NEW. Page dim behind bottom sheets and the desktop dialog.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Armenian", "Noto Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Identity card name, dialog title on desktop.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Remove confirm title, profile card name.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Menu items, error message, dialog body.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Uploading caption, error hint line, secondary meta.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sheet title and menu heading (sentence case, text-secondary).

styles.name: initials
styles.usage: Initials in the 56px avatar; scale to 40% of the circle. Bold so 19px+ counts as large text.

tokens.name: ui-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges; error icon gap.

tokens.name: ui-space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between sheet action rows; sheet top padding above the handle.

tokens.name: ui-space-3
tokens.usage: Error panel padding; avatar-to-name gap on the mobile card.

tokens.name: ui-space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on 390 (ADR-063), card padding, sheet side padding.

tokens.name: ui-space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between avatar and text in the desktop identity card.

tokens.name: ui-space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, desktop card padding.

tokens.name: ui-space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: ui-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, camera badge, spinner, icon circles.

tokens.name: ui-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, sheet action rows, menu, error panel.

tokens.name: ui-radius-card
tokens.usage: Profile card, sidebar card, identity card.

tokens.name: ui-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners, desktop dialog.

shadow.note: ui-shadow-card value assumed: copy the real one from styles.css.

tokens.name: ui-shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the camera badge.

tokens.name: ui-shadow-pop
tokens.usage: NEW. Desktop popup menu and header dropdown.

size.note: Avatar and target sizes for this feature.

tokens.name: avatar-header
tokens.usage: Header avatar (inside a 44px button on mobile; 36px desktop).

tokens.name: avatar-card
tokens.usage: Mobile profile card avatar (3.5rem).

tokens.name: avatar-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-identity
tokens.usage: Desktop identity card avatar (assumed size).

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Camera badge on 56/72px avatars; 28px on 96px.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control.
